title: 埃默里大学专家：世卫组织表现卓越，美国疾控中心能力下降令人痛心
speaker: Dr. Carlos Del Rio

segments.en: Well, first of all, I want to say that the World Health Organization has really done a remarkable job starting with their director general, Dr. Tedros, and then the rest of the WHO team.
segments.zh: 首先，世界卫生组织从总干事谭德塞博士到整个团队，都做得非常出色。

segments.en: Maria Vankerhoven and her team, they've done a tremendous job. You know, Dr. Tedros is there and side in Tenerife helping and providing leadership and talking to the Spanish government and ensuring that the boat was able to dock over there in the passengers can be safely and securely disembarked.
segments.zh: 玛丽亚·范克尔霍夫和她的团队也做得非常出色。谭德塞博士就在特内里费岛提供领导力，与西班牙政府沟通，确保船只安全靠岸，乘客安全下船。

segments.en: I think we have seen a much diminished CDC if you think about a prior outbreak, let's think the outbreak of Ebola. CDC very quickly was involved very CDC very quickly sent a team over there CDC was providing something very important, which is technical assistance.
segments.zh: 与之前的埃博拉疫情相比，我们看到疾控中心的能力大幅下降。当时疾控中心迅速介入，派遣团队，提供非常重要的技术支持。

segments.en: We're not seeing a lot of technical assistance happening for CDC right now. In fact, it almost seems like the CDC response occurred after many many days. It was almost, you know, too late, too little too late. And that's unfortunate because, you know, we need a strong CDC as American citizens.
segments.zh: 现在我们看不到疾控中心提供多少技术支持。实际上，疾控中心的反应似乎滞后了很多天，几乎可以说是太少、太迟。这很不幸，因为作为美国公民，我们需要一个强大的疾控中心。

segments.en: We want a strong CDC. You want a CDC that's a leader in global health, not only nationally, but globally. And to see as such a diminished CDC, to me as an infectious disease physician and as a public health expert is actually quite painful.
segments.zh: 我们希望疾控中心强大，成为全球健康领域的领导者，不仅在国内，也在全球。看到疾控中心如此衰落，作为传染病医生和公共卫生专家，我感到非常痛心。
